task: security negative-test suite; document and audit comprehensive negative test vectors: expired JWT, wrong signature, malformed authorization header, cross-tenant IDOR, replay of revoked tokens.

verified_source_anchors.description: Verifies token signature, expiration (exp), issuer (iss), and typ claim, rejecting expired or tampered tokens with 401.
Validates refresh token signature, expiration, and typ='refresh' claim with 401 on failure.
Performs case-insensitive RFC 7235 Bearer scheme detection.
Extracts raw bearer credentials without fallback to cookie transport.
Enforces transport anti-downgrade invariant: explicit Bearer header owns authentication; never falls back to cookie on invalid bearer.
Verifies explicit bearer credential validity for CSRF exemption; malformed or revoked bearer headers return False.
FastAPI dependency enforcing RBAC role boundaries (admin implicit access, under-privileged callers receive 403 Forbidden).
Manages refresh rotation (rotate_refresh, is_refresh_reused), JTI denylist (revoke, is_revoked), and no-PII telemetry hashing.
Enforces horizontal IDOR isolation on WorkspaceFolder by querying user_id == current_user.id (raises 404 on cross-user lookup).
Enforces horizontal IDOR isolation on CouncilCase for clinicians, raising 404 when non-owner requests case_id.
Enforces horizontal IDOR isolation on KnowledgeSource by owner_user_id check.

interface_assumptions: Security negative-test vectors execute completely hermetically in-memory with zero external network or database requirements.
Fail-closed paradigm: any cryptographic, temporal, scheme, or object-ownership mismatch unconditionally terminates with 401, 403, or 404.
Object-level IDOR defenses return 404 Not Found to prevent resource enumeration by unauthorized callers.
Zero plaintext PII is persisted in Redis security keys or emitted to application logs during token revocation or replay events.

test_commands_and_exit_codes.description: Execution of 36 security negative test vectors across 6 test suites covering expired tokens, wrong signatures, malformed headers, IDOR, token revocation replay, and HTTP middleware.
Hermetic runner executing full security negative suite with structured JSON telemetry summary.
